Quick Answers

Is this tablet good for kids?

Absolutely. The Galaxy Tab A11+ is a top pick for families — it has a bright 11" screen that's easy on the eyes, durable build, and Samsung's 2-year warranty. Parental controls via Samsung Kids let you manage screen time and content.

Does it support a keyboard or stylus?

The Tab A11+ supports Bluetooth keyboards and mice. Samsung's S Pen is not included but the tablet does work with compatible styluses. Check Amazon for the full accessory lineup.

Can I expand the storage?

Yes! There's a microSD card slot that supports up to 1TB of additional storage — plenty of room for movies, games, photos and apps.

Does it come with Prime delivery?

Samsung tablets sold on Amazon typically qualify for Prime shipping. Delivery speed depends on your location and Amazon inventory at the time of order.
